ValidationRule.description: Case record type is Finance-Collections and Status is a Closed Status and Case Resolution is Blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordTypeId = "012000000000g0DAAQ" && OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed - Resolved"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed - Duplicate"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed - Junk/Spam"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed - Termination/Grievance"), ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed - Rejected") ) && ISBLANK(Case_Resolution__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Resolution is required when closing a case
